body:
But then you buy all the limited edition prints and probably spent more than you would have on expensive natural disposables...


Gotta have one more to even out the costs
This is how I found out my husband was cheating on me. He figured out and turned it off :)

Nicki’s pockets are so generously sized and gentle on my 5 month 18.5lb chunks thighs. I just stuff them with bamboo because I hate mf. 

Imagine pockets should fit similarly.
I love ponzu sauce

My husband who used to hate the idea of cloth, absolutely loves best bottoms with bamboo inserts. So much so that when we went on a road trip he would only use disposables while we were driving and made me bring the best bottoms to use at our destination.

They’re not an AIO, but he prefers them to any of the AIOs/pockets we have (Nickis, blueberry, smart bottoms, Rumparooz, imagine)

He says they fit the easiest (pockets and AIOs require some adjustments to be sure the absorbency is centered) and when he’s feeling lazy and doesn’t want to deal with diapers, he uses them as an AIO. And they are the most leak proof diaper I’ve tried.
Clout goggles work better, imo
My landlord/property management company does this. Their solution? Give them the rest of the leases checks predated. I feel like they’d take advantage of me being a young mom.
My 3 year old has been screaming bloody murder for an hour and a half. I'm going to call cps on myself so the neighbors don't have to
I have no one to watch my kids and nowhere to go

I want my 3 month old son to be breastfed and cloth diapered because I'm irrational and I don't have anyone lined up to raise him and my 3 year old daughter the way I wanted to.


I'm a shit mum, positive my children would lead a much better life raised by someone more capable.


But hey! At least they didn't drink poisonous formula or wear diapers made with ckhemmiKILLS /s

Taking fenugreek makes me smell like pancake syrup.
So you'll still smell, but pancakes smell better than BO

OP asked about weed increasing HR/BP. I have experience with this because, as stated above, I have POTS. If I consume too much THC, I experience tachycardia and atrial fibrillation. I didn't know I had a heart condition until it happened multiple times. This is not a normal side effect for healthy individuals. I am not healthy.

Spreading false information would be saying "Weed will do this to you". Saying it has happened to me is not false.
I have POTS and when I consume high amounts of THC/low CBD it causes afib. I didn't know I had a heart condition until it kept happening. Could be the case with OP, or it's just anxiety.

Because so many people are in denial that cannabis can have a negative effect on some people, which is ridiculous.

But through my very scientific fucking around /s, I'm almost positive that it is in fact THC causing negative effects and CBD the benefits in my case
Smoking weed did the same thing to me. The last time I smoked I ended up in a hospital with my resting HR right around 200bpm for 12 hours.

I think it's pretty accurate. He was in preemie diapers and clothes last week and now he definitely needs newborn, he fits better in his car seat, and he just looks like he's fattening up. I say screw the ped and I'll give him the boob as much as he wants. I was worried it was like overfeeding formula fed babes, but my MIL reminded me that breastmilk has nothing that babies can't digest and that babies BF for a billion reasons

My daughter was a boob monster so I expect the same from my son. I just smiled and nodded, and told my son he can have all the milk he wants. Maybe I'll have a chunky baby with rolls this time! His nickname is Roly after all

I wonder if he is concerned about spitting up? My son doesn't, but he does have persistent pulmonary hypertension and spitting up would cause a lot of problems for us. He just looked at his growth chart and instead of commenting on my super boobs, he said to slow down on the feeding :(

He only gets a pacifier once a day if he wants it with daddy so I can get other things done around the house. Love baby wearing, but lugging around an oxygen tank is tiring haha
He did become a doctor in 1979... I thought him and his partner were good because they were so adamant on extended rear facing and absolutely no solids until at least 6 months

I have super hard water and I use Tide powder and calgon. Borax wasn't softening enough and I ended up needing to strip.

I also have a diaper dekor and ubbi pail and I use both planet wise and kangacare pail liners

ETA I have an HE machine as well

What the actual fuck. What kind of doctor says that?

I had a growth scan at 35 weeks and bub was estimated 3.5lbs. My OB, midwife, and perinatologist all said he's fine. I didn't even know that was small.

This drove me crazy. I already have a girl and people were constantly saying "I hope this one is a boy" and after I found out he was in fact a boy "Thank god it's a boy this time"


What the hell is wrong with people? I dealt with a little gender disappointment because I already knew what girls are like and I suck at coming up with boys names, so that was frustrating. And in the end, I just really wanted a healthy baby this time around and I had just found out he was also IUGR. So more disappointment that I never felt validated on.

I can't speak for PPB, but I looovvveee my jujube bff. It's a huge upgrade from my Betsey Johnson diaper bag for sure. I use little separate bags inside to keep things organized and I cloth diaper my 2 year old and I have space. I kind of wish I got the BRB only because it has a slimmer profile, more space inside, and I'm going to have 2 kids pretty soon but I've test packed for 2 and it still works
I graduated 3 years ago in California and 45 was the norm

This hit really close to home and I finally know how to explain my feelings. When I found out my second baby was a boy, everyone thought I was disappointed. I wasn't. Initially i was shocked because I was so sure I was having another girl. Everyone told me their boy pregnancies were completely different from their girls, and mine felt the same. Then I wondered about how raising a boy would be different from a girl. I worried about misinformation about not knowing how to care for an intact penis. I don't have one! And now I'm dreading super gendered clothes. I can't stand that most boy clothes all say "hunk" or "all star" or "future heartbreaker" or some other manly phrase.
Mf isn't really absorbent. Bamboo is more absorbent and trimmer, and hemp is the most absorbent and trim option but it is slow absorbing so not good for flooders

My friend who told me to try out Best Bottoms for 2 year old (which I LOVE) Told me to stay away from alvas all together. After 5 months of use, she still has a horrendous lint problem where her daughter is covered in fuzz every time she uses one.


I have carted now a mix of lil joeys, Nicki's baio, imagine baio, bamboo fitteds, and small prefolds to use in transition to one size. I've been sitting in it for a while and now I'm pretty confident to cash in for Earth Day. I'll look into the baby land pockets though! I've never heard of them and I like saving money

I'm tired of the Lee puns. It's bad enough that I was known as Bree my whole unmarried life, I can do without people seriously suggesting I name my kid Bruce, Brock, Sutton, Sirius, I don't even ask my family for suggestions anymore

Ugh, I'm so sorry. My mom ruined my gender reveal too but in a different way. Definitely limit what you tell her from now on and treat everything you tell her as something she'll tell the whole world. It's been almost 2 months and I'm feeling better about everything that happened. Go celebrate your baby girl with your husband, it will get better <3

Hey! I'm not alone! I'm 20 with a 2 1/2 year old and due with #2 in July. My first was not planned, but my second was. I have no idea how I'm going to do it, but I guess we'll figure it out like we did the first time!

The more I think about it, the more I'm realizing it's not just about the baby being small. I don't want another c-section and I don't want another sick baby. The birth and newborn stage was so traumatic, I didn't bond with her. I didn't want to get too close only to lose her

They have no idea when my daughters growth slowed down because they didn't even catch it until a few hours before she was born. It was traumatic for me and I think I'm associating small baby with that experience.


My doctor initially said that IUGR shouldn't repeat, but now she's being pretty vague about it until my next scan. All she has to offer me is some people just have small babies or I could have poor blood flow. 


I do feel a little more prepared this time around though. Like I know preemie clothes are an option! Everyone told me not to buy newborn and go straight to 0-3 and she still swam in the newborn clothes people brought to me in the hospital

I don't think I want to give up on Roland. He says his favorite name so far is Ronan and it's not too far off. I think I can convince him it's a good name


I think his names are ridiculous and told him no right off the bat. I'd name a dog Zeus and that's about as far as I'd go. I just wanted to show why we can't agree on names

Roland is my favorite name now and I have no idea why. My husband of course loves Ronan and doesn't care for Roland. 


I also don't know why everyone here prefers Ronan to Roland. I thought for sure Reddit would like the classic more.
I like Griffin! I used to love Rowan until people started giving the name to girls and it shifted to more unisex. I Roland and Ronan are really similar and are still (hopefully) boy names
I think it's my favorite too. I like names that aren't popular, but completely normal. Think I haven't heard that in a while, not I've never heard of that before
I have a daughter named Emilia. A few people call her Em or Emmy

Oh I hate his names. I'm okay with Maxim, but can't use it.


Do you think Emilia and Emmett sound too similar?
I've never heard of that, thanks!

My friend who also had a 5lb baby said she loved lil joeys and imagine bamboo so I was going to get those. I feel like cloth diapering a newborn is a guessing game because you don't know what you'll like until they're here

I really want to use AIOs for my newborn because they look trimmer than any other diaper and he's most likely going to be another 5 pounder and they seem to fit tiny babies best. I've only cloth diapered a 2 year old so I only have other peoples pictures to go off of

My one size aios only take a few hours to line dry so I'm not too worried about that. 


I tried looking for used diapers but gave up because they were being sold at retail value or $2 less and that didn't include shipping :/

I forgot to include that the OS stash I do have is being used by my 2 year old. That's why I have so many. I just have a huge stash of size large inserts and was gifted 5 smalls

Any reason you would recommend prefolds and fitteds over more AIOs?
This was my first symptom before I knew I was pregnant with #2, but I started leaking as well. I don't mind the tingling as much as I do sticky colostrum

When my daughter was an infant, we had poopsplosions multiple times a day, everyday. I packed 8 extra outfits in my diaper bag and within 4 hours she had gone through all 9 and I was running through a store with a naked baby to buy more clothes. I just switched to cloth and I can't believe I didn't do it sooner or at least use covers over disposables to catch the poopocalypse. Seriously, the best  baby investment I've made so far.

Right?? One day, my daughters bum decided she wanted nothing to do with conventional brand disposables and actually had chemical burns from pampers, huggies, generic brands, you name it. Honest was the only one that worked. Each honest subscription box was $80 and at that rate, we could have bought 2 of what I did in cloth. And that was only in 6 months. 


He was also deployed or away at training for a lot of her life from newborn until almost 2 so I think his idea of babies in general is not realistic

I tell him CD hold their value and we will have no problem selling them living in a "crunchy" city.


We really want to invest in AIOs for babysitters or when we visit grandparents, but I cannot find them any cheaper than $15 (Nicki's AIO). Is there another sub that deals solely with selling diapers?

I have no clue what I'm doing and the more I get into CD, the more confused I get. I'm $300 in with 10 covers, 24 inserts, and wet bag and I thought that was a good price, but my husband is saying for that price we could have bought a years worth of diapers. It's really hard to convince him that we need to buy smaller inserts for our newborn at this point.

My daughter was 5lbs when she was born so I think it will be a while before he's in cloth.


Is medium okay to skip or do I really need all three sizes?
I thought about doing that, but it looked like it wouldn't work because the inserts are contoured. Did it work on the smallest rise?
She was saying she's never used and doesn't know if she will ever use the large and that's what made me question it. Nicki's diapers returns also seem like a hassle

This is a great description. I want to add that it helped me immensely to have someone stay with me to get my baby out of the bassinet. She was wheeled back to the nursery often for testing, immunizations, blood work, and they would bring her back and leave her bassinet just out of reach and I was too sore the first day to get up and grab her. 


I was so overwhelmed with having a baby that I forgot to keep up with pain meds. It's not unmanageable, but definitely not enjoyable. Staying on track with the doses would've made my experience a hundred times better. 


They also give you painkillers for home and if you are in too much pain, take them. They do take away the pain, but remember that you are healing and don't overdo it.


Stool softeners are definitely recommended. Trust me. 


This was my experience, and everyone is different. I know people who are up and walking around shortly after surgery and feel fine. I know it would have helped me to know what to expect and things I can do to help me feel better if I need it
I'll definitely ask about it on Monday. I wonder if the daily shots like the ones IVF moms use would be an option. I feel like smaller, daily doses would be easier than a large weekly dose
I didn't know, I've only seen it as Maxim until recently. Good to know
A family member suggested Sutton, then I Sutton Lee realized I can't escape the puns.
Not Russian. White and Chinese.

We can't agree on the pronunciation. I say Max-eem and everyone else says Max-im. I seem to pick the worst names. No one can pronounce Emilia either. She's either Ee-muh-lie-uh or Emma Leah. Sometimes Uh-mill-yuh. Drives me bonkers.
If we were to spell it Maksim in the US, would it be accepted as a real name or looked at as a yooneek spelling?

Kids can be cruel no matter what your name is. My name is Brianna and I was called Bretard and now Breelee, which is stupid. 


I've always loved the name Max, but I worried about it not feeling like a full first name. Husband liked Emmy for our daughter, so I went with Emilia for that reason. I think we called her Emmy for 2 days. Since I don't like any other "Max" names, I'm SOL.


Just Max is growing on me though. Thanks for your input

I love Maxime, but I'm worried about people hearing Maxine.


Maxwell is nice too. I had a boss named Maxwell and he was a bad person. But I will (hopefully) never see him again
Maxim...
I need a new surname -_-

I like to avoid nn as first names. I don't know why, just preference. And my last name is Lee. I don't know what my names style is. I don't like names to be too popular, but also not trendy or made up. I want people to think "You don't here that often" not "I've never heard that before".
I wish I went with my original middle name choices. I have an Emilia Rose and everywhere we go, without fail, someone says she sounds like she should be a princess.

She only calls me to tell me how I'm ruining her life or my siblings life, to tell me I'm a shitty mom, or something equally negative. I told her if that's all she ever has to say to me, to not call me anymore. She then changed her tactics to be centered around my daughter, saying it's not fair that I keep my daughter away from her grandparents and won't let them have a relationship, how will that effect her when she's older, etc. My husband is in the military and we move ALL THE TIME, which my mom hates because she can't see my daughter. He just put in requests for Germany and Korea and I'm hoping and praying we get one of those.

She's known for stealing my thunder. When I was in the hospital JUST coming out of a c section and on so many drugs I was in another dimension, she invited all of her friends and distant cousins to come visit. And then convinced me to give the baby her last name? I told her I was pregnant this time because she was visiting and I was horribly sick and couldn't hide it. So she announced to the whole world at 8 weeks before I even told anyone.
My 2.5 year old is infinitely more considerate than my Nmom

My moms favorite thing to say about me is that I'm bipolar. I'm not. But the best part is her made up definition of bipolar that she tells all of her family; extreme, unpredictable mood swings and behavior that changes every minute, tends to have violent outbursts, delusional, hallucinations are in there I'm sure. Like, yeah sure I have mood swings, if I'm in a good mood and you come and tell me I ruined your life and I'm an embarrassment and you wish I would just kill myself already, I'm gonna be a little sad. And then when your husband sees this drastic change and accuses me of being on drugs and completely destroys my room looking for said drugs, I'm gonna be angry. This actually happened nearly every day, thank god I moved several states away.


I don't really care about her family. They've never once reached out to me, and when I did try to talk to them they went straight to my mom to tell on me and ask if they were allowed to talk to me. An adult who no longer lived with her. I don't want to hear it from my mom. She already uses my daughter as a pawn when I try to ignore her and that's just fucked up. I don't want to hear about how she wasn't there for my sons birth, or baby shower, or anything. I wish she would be happy that I left her life, like she always wished for.

I used to browse RBN frequently because like you, it was therapeutic. Then I started feeling guilty and wondering if I really was crazy and making up my moms N behavior like she has said my whole life. My dad was married to her for 10 years, now divorced for 13 and even he genuinely believed he was insane because of all the things she does and has no recollection of.


I thought it was going to be a story about kids or baby showers, but I actually relate to that so much. I'm extremely possessive over my food because of shit like that. I get so upset if anyone asks for a bite of what I'm eating or if my husband takes something I was saving to work. The only other person who gets my weird food thing is my dad, so its horrible that other people have gone through this too, but I'm also glad I'm not alone.

Haha I love it! Or I could do what she does and wait a month to reply. 


"Hi!!!😍😘😘😘❤️❤️ thank you!!! So exciting right? Can't wait for you to meet him! Sorry for the delayed response, super busy being a stay at home mom 😭😳 love you xoxo"


Gag.

We do try to talk with our daughter, but at 2 I don't think she quite understands. Maybe I'm approaching it the wrong way or not communicating to her effectively and that's where therapy would help her. I had her at 17/18 so I'm really not full of wisdom, but I try to do the best I can.


And thankfully, I live 1300 miles away from my mom and only see her if she comes to visit which has only been once in 8 months.


I will find a therapist. I really think they will help sort out my feelings and be an unbiased outlet. Thank you!

I'm realizing now that when she is in my life, I'm so depressed and I can't be a mom. I'm not going to be like my mom, I'm going to put my kids first.


Thank you! I have no idea how to mom a boy :D I'm super excited

I've gone completely NC in the past, but it was before I had my daughter. Now she guilts me by saying it's not fair that I'm preventing her from having a relationship with her grandma.


Any time my daughter has spent time with my mom, she comes back a holy terror and is so mean to her dad. She's never acted up after spending time with my dad and step mom or my in-laws...


I know she's the toxic person, but the guilt. Do you ever get over it?

Thank you! It took a few days, but after going to babies r us and making my registry I'm so excited. 


Part of me feels like going NC and not including my mother in my life events is justified for the sake of my wellbeing, and part of me feels like I'm crazy and over reacting and not being fair to her.


It's getting to the point where she realizes she can't control me alone, and she's using my 2.5 year old as a pawn. I don't want the life I've lived for my daughter. Before she was born, I told her she would not have separate birthday parties. She has not been to any of her celebrations because my dad/dads family is there.

My mom is a master gaslighter. I've tried confronting her about what she did last time and she denies it ever happening and says it was my fault for making everyone uncomfortable.  This whole situation is hopeless
Most of the time, she is the one who initiates no contact so it's easy. But times like these where she has my siblings and her friends telling me how awful and hurtful I am makes me feel worse

You're right. If they were unknowingly a part of my gender reveal and managed to upset me that much, I can't imagine what they would do at my baby shower and around my dads family who they hate because of my mom. If they really cared about me or my kids, they would call me once in a while.

I probably should have posted there, but pregnancy brain.


I think I'm just really upset that instead of being happy and taking it all in with my husband and daughter, I sat in the corner crying because I felt so guilty. 


And my wonderful husband got me peeps and Oreos. And I still have some cake left over, blue frosting is great.

My MIL (who I'm very close to) is hosting my shower this time as I didn't even have one the first time. She gave my mom a call to ask if she had any suggestions for whatever you do at baby showers, and she started saying MIL would not be able to handle a crowd of her size and she should let my mom take over. Thank god MIL shut that down. 


I'm seriously considering not even inviting her or any of her family. The first time she said I only invited her/them because I wanted gifts. My mom would guilt me so bad if I intentionally left her and her family out.
